basic_info.description: Meticulously maintained and thoughtfully updated, this classic Marina-style three-unit building offers a rare opportunity in the heart of the Marina. Delivered entirely vacant, the property is perfectly suited for an owner-occupant or investor alike. The top-floor residence, with its graceful proportions and timeless character, features two bedrooms, one and a half bathrooms, a generous living room with a gas fireplace, a formal dining room, and abundant closet space. The middle flat mirrors the charm with two bedrooms, one bath, a cozy fireplace, and tasteful updates. On the ground level, a charming studio tucked behind the garage provides flexibility as a guest suite, home office, or additional income opportunity. Modern enhancements blend seamlessly with the building's period detail, including updated mechanical systems, seismic upgrades, in-unit laundry in the upper residences, and kitchens with granite counters and stainless steel appliances. A sunny backyard patio adds to the appeal, creating a bright and inviting retreat. With two-car parking and a prime Marina location, this property combines timeless architectural character with contemporary convenience, an exceptional opportunity to live, invest, or both in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods.
